facts.text: Naran is 119 km from Mansehra city and 65 km from Babusar Top pass.
Kaghan Valley can be reached by road via Balakot, Mansehra, and Abbottabad, or from Islamabad.
facts.quote: via the towns of Balakot, Mansehra, and Abbottabad

facts.text: From Chilas to Naran by bus takes 4 hours and costs Rs 1500 (2025).
Buses and smaller transport go from town to town, and for side destinations you can find a jeep or walk.
facts.quote: Busses and smaller transport goes from town to town

facts.text: Towns are small enough to explore on foot.
facts.quote: Towns are small enough to explore on foot.

facts.text: Lake Saiful Muluk can be accessed from Naran by jeep on a 14-km road open during summer, about half an hour; if the road is closed or you want to walk, it is an easy, gradual 3-6 hour walk.
Kaghan Valley is at its best in the summer months May to September.
facts.quote: at its best in the summer months (May to September)

facts.text: In May the temperature is maximum 11 °C and minimum 3 °C.
The road beyond Naran is snowbound throughout the winter, and movement is also restricted during the monsoon season.
Fishing licenses are issued by the Fisheries Department at Naran.
facts.quote: Fishing licenses are issued by the Fisheries Department at Naran.

facts.text: There is a Rs 500 (2025) fee to enter the national park at Lake Saiful Muluk.
facts.quote: Rs 500 (2025) to enter the national park

facts.text: A bus from Chilas to Naran costs Rs 1500 (2025).
A jeep from Naran to Lake Saiful Muluk costs Rs 1500 in 2025.
At Chilas Zero Point, the Kaghan Valley road closes daily at 17:00 for traffic from the North and opens again early morning.
facts.quote: gets closed daily at 17:00 for traffic from the North

facts.text: Lake Dudipatsar is remote, with almost no people there and no hotels or restaurants.
The road to Lake Dudipatsar is very difficult.
facts.quote: very difficult road with no hotels or restaurants
